title: Automatic reconnection after ignition
description: The system shall automatically reconnect a previously paired phone after the vehicle ignition is switched on.

title: Reconnection within ten seconds
description: The system shall complete Bluetooth phone reconnection within 10 seconds after the Bluetooth subsystem becomes available.

title: Reuse stored pairing information
description: The system shall use stored pairing information to reconnect the phone without requiring the user to repeat the pairing process.

title: Transient reconnection retry
description: The system shall retry the Bluetooth connection once when the first reconnection attempt fails because of a transient communication error.

title: Restore supported Bluetooth profiles
description: After reconnection, the system shall restore the supported phone and media audio profiles.

title: Record reconnection diagnostics
description: The system shall record diagnostic events for the start, completion, failure, and duration of each reconnection attempt.

title: Handle Bluetooth-disabled phones
description: The system shall stop automatic reconnection attempts when Bluetooth is disabled on the paired phone.
